pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Complex, non-polygonal geometries with high-frequency edge serration and internal textural grain; patches show a gradient of decreasing spatial area from the anterior neck to the posterior flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-toned interstitial pathways forming a continuous topological graph with high node density; pixel thickness is minimal relative to patch diameter and remains consistent across the mid-section.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Geometric contour of the mane shows a serrated profile with low-amplitude, high-frequency jaggedness along the visible neck segment.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: Structural discontinuity in the mane silhouette at the posterior-most visible point of the neck near the shoulder junction.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Multiple dark, hemispherical nodular protrusions located on the dorsal ridge and upper lateral flank, characterized by localized hyper-pigmentation and textural disruption.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, dark, raised cutaneous nodules on the upper back and shoulder; three distinct dark-colored avian silhouettes (Oxpeckers) are present on the dorsal and mid-flank regions.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible interaction with multiple avian symbionts (Oxpeckers) localized to areas of skin nodules.
